Figure 1. Number of AIDS-related deaths and mortality rate among state prisoners, 1991–2015

Note: AIDS-related deaths were based on the jurisdiction population from 1991 to 2000 and the custody population from 2001 to 2015. Use caution when comparing data prior to 2001 to data from 2001 and beyond. Jurisdiction refers to the legal authority of state and federal correctional officials over a prisoner, regardless of where the prisoner is held. See appendix table 2 for estimates.
Source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, National Prisoner Statistics Program, 1991–2000; and Deaths in Custody Reporting Program, 2001–2015.
